data.name: Nafeesa
data.gender_notes: Nafeesa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nafeesa is a Quranic name that refers to a pure and virtuous woman. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes innocence and faithfulness. The name Nafeesa carries the meaning “Pure, Virtuous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafeesa usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A virtuous and pious woman who is loved by Allah.
data.etymology: Nafeesa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Virtuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafeesa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
